Plan label: WORKSTATION - 238 NOS. Sheet tables: 239 on the two furniture layouts, 238 on the RCP sheet.

labels CABIN-03, CABIN-01, CABIN-02; 3 cabin furniture sets (director desk + chair + 2 visitor chairs)
labels 16 PAX CONFERENCE ROOM, 8 PAX MEETING RM 01, 8 PAX MEETING RM 02 (both 8-pax rooms are labelled 'RM 02' in the CAD)

lockers.note: Locker units are drawn once in plan (one rectangle per column of lockers). Tiers are not in a 2D plan; the label counts divided by the drawn units give 6 tiers in every run.

_proof.method: One row per chair block instance (sofas: one per place). Room = the CAD room polygon containing the chair (rooms are the spaces closed by wall, glass and column lines with doors closed, named by the CAD text inside). Work seat = a work chair not in an operator room; desk pairing (chair nested in a desk block, or a desk block within 1.0 m) is reported per seat in desk_pair.
